name: Kavita
description: Kavita, a reader for comics, manga and books in the browser and in e-reader apps that use OPDS (Open Publication Distribution System). It reads your books and comics folders and never changes them.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

changed: The help names four phone apps that work with Kavita: KOReader, Kover, Sutra and Komic.
Plainer wording in the text and help pages. How it works has not changed.

fixed: **Making the first account:** a fresh install now gets a sign-in key long enough for Kavita, so making the first account no longer ends with "400 Error, Something went wrong when registering user". If that happened to you, its Problems help topic has the short repair.

changed: **Clearer words:** its description spells out OPDS, the Open Publication Distribution System.
**Logo description:** where its logo stands on its own, a screen reader says "Kavita logo", the plug-in's name, instead of a description of the symbol.

added: **A logo** in Settings, Plug-ins and in the Catalogue.
changed: Needs Starboard with plug-in API 1.14 or later. A Starboard with an older plug-in API keeps version 1.0.0.

added: Kavita as a plug-in, outside the main install, on its own page on your home network.
